data.name: Henson
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'heh' meaning 'hay' and 'nysan' meaning 'enclosure'. The name Henson may have originated as a nickname for someone who lived or worked in an enclosed area, or it may have been given to someone with an attractive or strong appearance. In the English language, 'Henson' can be interpreted as 'handsome' or 'strong'.
